codingUnit: inspected source window; overlapping codes aggregated to source-document presence

codes.label: Contact and disclosure
codes.definition: Forecasts, readiness or conditions concerning alleged contact/disclosure; not verified events.

codes.label: Beliefs, interpretation and agency
codes.definition: How beliefs, interpretations and personal action are said to shape experience; qualifications and dissent remain visible.

codes.label: Fear, feeling and self-worth
codes.definition: Fear, emotional interpretation, confidence or felt empowerment; no clinical efficacy inference.

codes.label: Practice and alignment
codes.definition: Suggested reflection, attention, enthusiasm, meditation or symbolic spiritual practice.

codes.label: Consciousness and ontology
codes.definition: Source accounts of reality, dimensions, incarnation, divine identity or consciousness; no physical validation.

codes.label: Claimed beings and identity
codes.definition: Named or described beings, lineage, origin or alleged communication roles; source attribution only.

codes.label: Validation, qualification and criticism
codes.definition: How an experience is interpreted, uncertainty expressed, evidence invoked, or a claim criticized.

codes.label: Bodily or health-related claims
codes.definition: Subjective bodily experiences or health-related interpretation; advertisements and interview discussion must remain distinguishable.

codes.label: Relationships and collective ethics
codes.definition: Relationships, shared needs, social responsibility or claims about collective development.

codes.label: Publisher framing and promotion
codes.definition: Advertising, subscriptions, programs or media calls to action. This code alone does not establish monetization.

annotationMethod: AI-agent semantic close reading; no external model inference or human annotation
sampling: Fixed beginning/middle/ending30second targets and one60second question-marker/topic-keyword enriched target per ASR; segment boundaries can extend targets; first250whitespace words per Daniel item; full Paul PDF extraction; three post-hoc NMF-term windows, deliberate full reading plus a bounded purpose-guidance window in the single Athina comparison source, and four post-hoc entity-spelling contexts
wordCountMethod: Python str.split whitespace tokens for both numerator and denominator; differs from regex counts in some inherited primary metadata
quotePolicy: No raw source text or verbatim quotations in public reading/Q&A artifacts; full windows remain private
qaMeaning: AI paraphrase candidates. Interview, fragmentary, rhetorical/self-question, secondary-report and analyst-constructed authored prompts are separate kinds.
comparisonMeaning: Prompt-family membership is an AI analytic grouping, not validated question equivalence, answer agreement, entity identity, or independent evidence.
